The Montgomery reducer itself is exhaustively exact (c3 rebutted) and the specific inverse/conjugated-twiddle mechanism was ruled out (c2 rebutted) — the kernel is wrong via some other twiddle/bank layout error, but the correctness failure against the tol-0 contract is directly established on in-scope canonical inputs.
